$comment: Pack Rat Put away v1 (issue #131), the two files between the TazUO panel and the app. `request`: <data>/inbox/<adapter>/putaway-request.json, written by the panel (adapters/tazuo/packrat-panel.py) and read by the app (app/put-away.mts's checkPutAwayRequest, at most 4096 bytes), which also refuses one whose requestedAt is over 60 s old or 5 s ahead, or whose clickedAt is after it or over an hour before; those time rules are beyond this schema. `reply`: <data>/bridge/<adapter>/putaway.json, written by the app (app/services/organize.mts) and read by the panel, which matches it to its request by id. Restricted to the keyword subset app/schema/validate.mts supports. The shared request cases are app/fixtures/contract-cases/put-away.json.

container.$comment: the serial of the container the player picked

requestedAt.$comment: RFC 3339, when this request was written

clickedAt.$comment: RFC 3339, when Put away was clicked: every request of one run carries it

id.$comment: the request's id, or null when the request named none the app could use

trip.$comment: the queued trip's command id, whose result the panel reads from the bridge's status.json; with none, nothing was queued
